GPTR-F-001-S134.title: Scope Enforcement Core Logic Engine
GPTR-F-001-S134.description: Implement the core validation engine that inspects every GPTReader request (collection, filters, fields, limits) against the allowlist schema and blocks any disallowed access before query execution.

GPTR-F-001-S135.title: Azure Function Request Pipeline Enforcement Hook
GPTR-F-001-S135.description: Integrate the enforcement engine into the Azure Function request pipeline so that all inbound GPTReader API calls are validated prior to authentication, execution, and data access.

GPTR-F-001-S136.title: Scope Enforcement Test Suite (Unit + Integration + Adversarial)
GPTR-F-001-S136.description: Develop comprehensive tests validating allowlist enforcement including valid queries, rejected queries, boundary conditions, and adversarial attempts (e.g., unauthorized collections, field injection, operator abuse).
